Introduction
This document outlines the 
minor maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every 5 years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Mohamed Salah El Din Badawy, tested by eng Abd El Wahab Abd El Wahab Ahmed, 
 accepted 
 by eng. Ahmed El Hosiny general 
 director, 
 revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader EL Nagar, 
 and approved by eng. Mohamed El Sarag Damietta PS head sector
This document is 
 accepted 
 by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS 
 coordinator, and certified by accountant; 
 Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman;
 EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well 
 trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Personal protective equipment must 
 be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses).
The operator, who is inside the 
 stator, is deprived from any metallic or magnetic object (kees, phones, tape 
 measure, chain ).
Protect the inferior part of 
 endwinding and core, with a rubber carpet or plastic film, which will move with 
 a make progress expertise.
Supply of necessity, by 
 intermediate of separate cubicle, the eventual appliance, and lighting put on 
 work inside the core stator.
Tools and Equipment
Megger (500 5000) volt
Multimeter, Air blower
Complete maintenance tool set
Contact resistance tester
Cleaning solvent
